name: createULID
description: Generates a ULID, a 26-character unique identifier that sorts by creation time.

params.name: type
params.description: `monotonic` makes each ULID greater than the last, even within the same millisecond. `hash` makes a repeatable ULID from `input1` and `input2`. When omitted, a standard random ULID is generated.

params.name: input1
params.description: A number used to build the ULID. Only used when `type` is `hash`.

params.name: input2
params.description: A string used to build the ULID. Only used when `type` is `hash`.
